summary: Iteration 62 — tested the 3 new Sanctus features. Backend: GET /api/sites returns 28 curated Catholic sites (seed idempotent; lat/lng/relics/saints/miracles/source_url all present), GET /api/sites/{id|slug} works, 404 on unknown, Accept-Language es/it localizes via translation cache (first call cold ~30s, subsequent cached). GET /api/virtues/plans now carries a badge object {tier, fallen, completed_days, elapsed, gold_max, silver_max, final} with sane math (fallen = elapsed - completed_days). PUT /api/preferences accepts marital_status + vocation and GET returns them. 10/10 backend tests passed. Frontend (mobile 390x844): /community/map renders with Leaflet map + colored markers + legend; list-toggle (map-toggle-list) opens list; tapping map-list-lourdes opens the bottom-sheet showing history + Relics + Saints + Miracles & Apparitions + Learn more + Close (Close dismisses correctly). Profile Walk-with-Christ section shows the lock-icon Private exclaimer + marital/vocation chips; pref-marital-single + pref-vocation-religious-life tapped and persisted (verified via GET /api/preferences). Virtus plan detail (/virtus/plan/{id}) shows the PerseveranceBadge card with medal, 'Gold · Current standing · 5 of 7 days kept · 2 missed' and badge-info-toggle expands the rule. No critical issues. Non-blocking console warnings: deprecated shadow* props and props.pointerEvents (RNW deprecations, app-wide cosmetic only).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' across multiple screens. Cosmetic only on web; consider migrating to boxShadow / elevation.
Console warns: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. App-wide non-blocking.

action_items: (optional) Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow and props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents to silence RNW deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: catholic_sites.py uses get_lang() with translation cache (i18n_translate.translate_texts) — first Spanish/Italian /api/sites request is ~30s while cold (28 sites × many strings). Consider warming the cache or paginating to keep mobile perceived latency low; currently fine because results are cached in Mongo per-language.
virtues._compute_badge bounds elapsed to plan length and treats today as still in-progress — math validated (fallen = elapsed - completed_days).
